name: Exercise 5.141
description: Exercise 5.141. The literal claim that every subsystem is a system mode is false. A fully checked finite counterexample: the resultant of a lone revealing component is a subsystem of the cascade that hides that component's output, but it is not a system mode because the exhibitor readout is constant.

elements.text: Source Exercise 5.141, lines 416. The universal claim is refuted unconditionally: `IsSubsystemOf loneSystem pairSystem` and `¬ IsSystemMode loneSystem pairSystem`.
Lean theorem `subsystem_isSystemMode_or_counterexample`. Status: counterexample; fidelity: faithful. No extra hypotheses.
Unconditional finite counterexample: a subsystem whose readout separates two states cannot be a mode of a cascade whose external readout is constant.
